notes: Launch offers (ADR-0031, docs/07 section 2.1). Prices are minor units per currency: the first currency is the Stripe Price's own, the others are its currency_options. App Store and Google Play prices are set in their consoles from the same table. Load with python -m app.modules.billing.stripe_setup.
